about.description: KUMA is a protocol that packages short-dated sovereign fixed-income exposure into onchain instruments designed to earn yield while remaining more accessible than traditional bond rails. It uses structured products that represent government-bill style risk and return, aiming to make sovereign yield usable within onchain liquidity, savings, and collateral workflows.
